messages.body: Hi Alex!! We're short on hands. Could you chaperone the field trip on Nov 12 AND run the bake sale table on Nov 14? You'd be a lifesaver.

note.text: Alex told Rosa in September that Alex can take only one volunteer slot per month this fall because of work.

question: Should I take both slots?
fact: The owner can take only one volunteer slot per month this fall, and told Rosa so in September.
